Name: Percent of Max Stamina and Health Regeneration
Author: MercuriusXeno
Description:
Adds percentage-based health and stamina regeneration with a simple config menu.
The minimum for both is 0 (no regen) and you can control them separately.
Health can regen up to 100% per second, while Stamina can regen up to 10% per second.
Stamina is essentially infinite at values above 1% but do what you like.
Defaults that feel good (to me) are 0.2% for both.

I made it so the sliders have small steps on the low end, but get bigger as you increase the % so it's easier to find the value you want.

[/url]Changelog:
v1.0.1
﻿Update. you can go from 0% to 100% for health, and up to 10% for stamina. Increments are dynamic for ease-of-use.
﻿Regen resolution (time between health/stamina updates) in this version is designed to be a bit more smooth.
v1.0.0
﻿Mod released. you can go from 0% to 2.5% in increments of 0.1%, for both health and stamina.
﻿Regen timescale in this version is strictly per-second, which can be sluggish.

There is absolutely nothing wrong with version 1.0.0; if you prefer it, feel free to keep using it.
